evidence: Static source review only; no container was run by this reviewer, so this is not a measured double-seed comparison. (1) Static baseline: solution/solve.sh only does `cp -a "$(dirname "$0")/app/." /app/` and deletes the disposable DB under /app; no npm install, curl, wget, git clone, code generation or build step. A grep of solution/ for http(s) URLs, fetch-from-network, CDN, child_process returned nothing except the browser's same-origin `fetch(path, ...)` at public/js/app.js:40; index.html lines 7, 52-54 load only /styles.css and /js/*.js. Dependencies are exact pins (package.json: better-sqlite3 12.4.1, express 5.1.0) matching environment/Dockerfile global installs. (2) Seeding: src/db.js:122-124 seeds once when users is empty; every seeded row comes from the co-located src/seed_data.json, which is byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json (sha256 1b390154...bcf7 for both). Seeded ids are literal or derived (`GR-${offer_id}` db.js:162, `RM-${offer_id}-${kind}` db.js:167, `RA-${offer_id}` db.js:172); all created_at values are the constant REF (db.js:127, 132, 158-177). (3) Clock: no Date.now(), argument-less new Date(), Math.random or performance.now anywhere in solution/. `const now = () => R.refAt(db)` (src/index.js:62) reads system_clock (src/rules.js:17-21), seeded from reference_moment 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z, which matches hireops_rules.md:59-60 ('Nothing in this app reads the operating system's clock'). All `new Date(x)` calls in rules.js:29-42 and public/js parse supplied instants; display formatting pins locale en-US and timeZone UTC (public/js/app.js:63, index.js:78). List reads use explicit ORDER BY (index.js:227-240). (4) Only randomness: `uid` = crypto.randomBytes(4) (index.js:63) used for change-set ids (change-sets.js:109) and as a collision fallback for revised offer ids after the deterministic `${o.id}-R` (index.js:377-378, change-sets.js:133), plus the session token (index.js:112). None is a pinned value: a grep of tests/, instruction.md and environment/instructions for OFF-/CS-/RM-/GR-/EC-/RA- literals found none, and hireops_rules.md:203-204 states record identifiers may be generated and their format is the builder's choice. The 25 s SSE keep-alive (index.js:51) writes a comment frame and moves no figure. (5) Frozen bytes: all 14 solution files in the frozen snapshot equal the current project files and the hashes listed in raw-evidence-index.json sampled for solve.sh/seed. Housekeeping observation, not a task-package defect: `git status` shows six solution files (public/js/app.js, change-sets.js, hireops.js, styles.css, src/change-sets.js, src/index.js) modified relative to HEAD, i.e. the frozen candidate is hash-bound by the manifest but not yet a git commit; commit the candidate bytes before packaging so the reference is a committed baseline in the repository sense too.
